Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=34, page 34. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=34 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the same text. The PC website card list<ref name="cl-1261_95">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref> shows the same card with the card list's usual notation (icons written out or dropped, quotes as single quotes); that is not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026); it also writes “Cancel Lando System? OR” (no full stop after the question mark; the slip prints “Lando System?.” as published) — a capitals/punctuation-only difference, held for the wiki owner's ruling and not made a version.
